sentence: We can define a recurrence based on the fact that we can build a nice representation for $ n $ by adding powers of 2 (up to 2 times each) to smaller numbers.

sentence:
Let’s define: $$
R(n) = \text{number of nice representations of } n
$$
sentence-category-reason: Defines the function R(n), setting notation.

sentence:
We can use the following recurrence: $$
R(n) = \sum_{k=0}^{\lfloor \log_2 n \rfloor} \sum_{i=0}^{\min(2, \left\lfloor \frac{n}{2^k} \right\rfloor)} R(n - i \cdot 2^k)
$$
sentence-category-reason: States a recurrence relation deduced for R(n).
